title: Quintessential Char Grilled Algerian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Algerian dish featuring char grilled lamb, horseradish, and spices, served in a banana leaf vessel, this meal is perfect for a healthy dinner option, with anti-inflammatory properties and a unique flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, horseradish, garlic, ginger, cumin, and coriander.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the banana leaves by cutting them into large squares and brushing with water.
Once the lamb is cooked, remove it from the grill and wrap each skewer in a banana leaf square.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with fresh herbs and a side of couscous or rice.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
